description: Header file defining internal abstractions and functions for string formatting arguments in the Abseil C++ library, including type traits, conversion mechanisms, and argument handling.

classes.name: FormatArgImpl
classes.description: Type-erased handle to a format argument, managing storage, type conversion, and dispatching for formatting.

methods.name: FormatArgImpl(const T& value)
methods.description: Constructor that stores a value as a format argument, with type decay and storage policy.

methods.name: Dispatch<T>(Data, FormatConversionSpecImpl, void*)
methods.description: Dispatches the argument to the appropriate conversion function based on type and conversion specifier.
